audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot priestly ordination text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for priestly consecration, offerings, blood on ear/thumb/toe, seven-day ordination, daily offering, meeting place, and Divine dwelling.

verses.restored: This is the matter you shall do to them to sanctify them to serve as priests to me: take one bull, two rams, complete ones,

familiar.text: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

modern.text: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,

original.text: וְזֶ֨ה הַדָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֑י לְ֠קַח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר וְאֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם

verses.restored: and unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil; of fine wheat flour you shall make them.

familiar.text: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

modern.text: along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour,

original.text: וְלֶ֣חֶם מַצּ֗וֹת וְחַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן סֹ֥לֶת חִטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Put them in one basket and bring them near in basket, and the bull and two rams.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

modern.text: put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֤ אוֹתָם֙ עַל סַ֣ל אֶחָ֔ד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּסָּ֑ל וְאֶ֨ת הַפָּ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֵילִֽם

verses.restored: Bring Aaron and his sons near to entrance of tent of meeting and wash them with water.

familiar.text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

modern.text: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

original.text: וְאֶת אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת בָּנָיו֙ תַּקְרִ֔יב אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: Take garments and clothe Aaron with tunic, robe of ephod, ephod, breastpiece, and gird him with woven band of ephod.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

modern.text: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת הַבְּגָדִ֗ים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת הַכֻּתֹּ֔נֶת וְאֵת֙ מְעִ֣יל הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְאֶת הָאֵפֹ֖ד וְאֶת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ֣ ל֔וֹ בְּחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד

verses.restored: Set turban on his head, and put holy crown on turban.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

modern.text: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְנָתַתָּ֛ אֶת נֵ֥זֶר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַל הַמִּצְנָֽפֶת

verses.restored: Take anointing oil, pour on his head, and anoint him.

familiar.text: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

modern.text: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

original.text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְיָצַקְתָּ֖ עַל רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Bring his sons near and clothe them with tunics.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

modern.text: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.

original.text: וְאֶת בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת

verses.restored: Gird them with sash, Aaron and his sons, and bind caps on them; priesthood shall be theirs as age-long statute. You shall fill hand of Aaron and hand of his sons.

familiar.text: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

modern.text: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons. The Order of the Sacrifices (Leviticus 8:22–36)

original.text: וְחָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָהֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כְּהֻנָּ֖ה לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ יַֽד אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְיַד בָּנָֽיו

verses.restored: Bring bull before tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay hands on head of bull.

familiar.text: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.

modern.text: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת הַפָּ֔ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּֽר

verses.restored: Slaughter bull before YHWH, entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֥ אֶת הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Take from blood/life of bull and put on horns of altar with your finger, and pour all blood/life at base of altar.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

modern.text: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

original.text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל קַרְנֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶת כָּל הַדָּ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: Take all fat covering inward parts, lobe above liver, two kidneys and fat on them, and turn them to smoke on altar.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

modern.text: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

original.text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֗ אֶֽת כָּל הַחֵלֶב֮ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵ֗ת הַיֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת הַחֵ֖לֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֖ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה

verses.restored: But flesh of bull, its skin, and its dung you shall burn with fire outside camp; it is sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.

modern.text: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

original.text: וְאֶת בְּשַׂ֤ר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת עֹר֣וֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ תִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא

verses.restored: Take one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay hands on head of ram.

familiar.text: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

modern.text: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

original.text: וְאֶת הָאַ֥יִל הָאֶחָ֖ד תִּקָּ֑ח וְסָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל

verses.restored: Slaughter ram, take its blood/life and throw on altar all around.

familiar.text: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

modern.text: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.

original.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֖ אֶת הָאָ֑יִל וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת דָּמ֔וֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ֥ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Cut ram into pieces, wash inward parts and legs, put them on pieces and on its head.

familiar.text: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

modern.text: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.

original.text: וְאֶ֨ת הָאַ֔יִל תְּנַתֵּ֖חַ לִנְתָחָ֑יו וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ קִרְבּוֹ֙ וּכְרָעָ֔יו וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל נְתָחָ֖יו וְעַל רֹאשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Turn all ram to smoke on altar; it is burnt offering to YHWH, soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת כָּל הָאַ֨יִל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיח֔וֹחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא

verses.restored: Take second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay hands on head of ram.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

modern.text: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.

original.text: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל

verses.restored: Slaughter ram, take from its blood/life and put on lobe of right ear of Aaron and his sons, on thumb of their right hand and big toe of their right foot, and throw blood/life on altar all around.

familiar.text: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

modern.text: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Sprinkle the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.

original.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמוֹ֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְזָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת הַדָּ֛ם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Take from blood/life on altar and anointing oil, sprinkle on Aaron and garments, and on his sons and garments; he and garments and sons and garments will be holy.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

modern.text: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒ וְהִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ וְעַל בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וְקָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּבְגָדָ֔יו וּבָנָ֛יו וּבִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Take from ram the fat, fat tail, fat covering inward parts, lobe of liver, two kidneys and fat on them, and right thigh, for it is ram of filling.

familiar.text: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

modern.text: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן הָ֠אַיִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת הַחֵ֣לֶב הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת הַחֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא

verses.restored: And one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer from basket of unleavened bread before YHWH.

familiar.text: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:

modern.text: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

original.text: וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וַֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִסַּל֙ הַמַּצּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Put all on palms of Aaron and palms of his sons and wave them as wave offering before YHWH.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

modern.text: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Take them from their hand and turn them to smoke on altar upon burnt offering, as soothing scent before YHWH; it is fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל הָעֹלָ֑ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיח֨וֹחַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Take breast of ram of Aaron's filling and wave it as wave offering before YHWH; it shall be your portion.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.

modern.text: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.

original.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמָנָֽה

verses.restored: Sanctify breast of wave offering and thigh of contribution that is waved and contributed from ram of filling, from what is Aaron's and his sons'.

familiar.text: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

modern.text: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.

original.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵאֵיל֙ הַמִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבָנָֽיו

verses.restored: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as age-long due from children of Israel, for it is contribution from peace offerings, their contribution to YHWH.

familiar.text: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the LORD from their peace offerings.

original.text: וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחָק עוֹלָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them and to fill their hand in them.

familiar.text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

modern.text: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.

original.text: וּבִגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן יִהְי֥וּ לְבָנָ֖יו אַחֲרָ֑יו לְמָשְׁחָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם וּלְמַלֵּא בָ֖ם אֶת יָדָֽם

verses.restored: Seven days shall the priest from his sons wear them, the one coming into tent of meeting to minister in holy place.

familiar.text: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.

modern.text: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days. Food for the Priests

original.text: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖יו מִבָּנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֥ת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: Take ram of filling and boil its flesh in holy place.

familiar.text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

modern.text: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.

original.text: וְאֵ֛ת אֵ֥יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֖ים תִּקָּ֑ח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֥ אֶת בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בְּמָקֹ֥ם קָדֹֽשׁ

verses.restored: Aaron and his sons shall eat flesh of ram and bread in basket at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

original.text: וְאָכַ֨ל אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת בְּשַׂ֣ר הָאַ֔יִל וְאֶת הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: They shall eat those things by which atonement was made to fill their hand and sanctify them; a stranger shall not eat, for they are holy.

familiar.text: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

modern.text: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.

original.text: וְאָכְל֤וּ אֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֻּפַּ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם לְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת יָדָ֖ם לְקַדֵּ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑ם וְזָ֥ר לֹא יֹאכַ֖ל כִּי קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֵֽם

verses.restored: If any flesh of filling or bread remains until morning, burn remnant with fire; it shall not be eaten, for it is holy.

familiar.text: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

modern.text: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

original.text: וְֽאִם יִוָּתֵ֞ר מִבְּשַׂ֧ר הַמִּלֻּאִ֛ים וּמִן הַלֶּ֖חֶם עַד הַבֹּ֑קֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֤ אֶת הַנּוֹתָר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל כִּי קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֽוּא

verses.restored: Thus you shall do to Aaron and sons according to all I commanded you; seven days you shall fill their hand.

familiar.text: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

modern.text: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לְאַהֲרֹ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ כָּ֔כָה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֹתָ֑כָה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תְּמַלֵּ֥א יָדָֽם

verses.restored: A bull for sin/misalignment offering you shall offer each day for atonements; you shall cleanse altar by making atonement upon it, and anoint it to sanctify it.

familiar.text: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

modern.text: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

original.text: וּפַ֨ר חַטָּ֜את תַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה לַיּוֹם֙ עַל הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֙ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּמָֽשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Seven days you shall make atonement for altar and sanctify it, and altar shall be Holy of Holies; all touching altar shall be holy.

familiar.text: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

modern.text: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy. The Daily Offerings (Numbers 28:1–8)

original.text: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹת֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים כָּל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בַּמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִקְדָּֽשׁ

verses.restored: This is what you shall offer upon altar: two lambs, sons of a year, day by day continually.

familiar.text: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

modern.text: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.

original.text: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם תָּמִֽיד

verses.restored: One lamb you shall offer in morning, and second lamb you shall offer between evenings.

familiar.text: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

modern.text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.

original.text: אֶת הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם

verses.restored: A tenth of fine flour mixed with quarter hin of beaten oil, and drink offering quarter hin wine, for one lamb.

familiar.text: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.

modern.text: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.

original.text: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין וְנֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: The second lamb you shall offer between evenings; according to morning grain offering and drink offering you shall do for it, as soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לָּ֔הּ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Continual burnt offering throughout your generations at entrance of tent of meeting before YHWH, where I will meet with you, to speak to you there.

familiar.text: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

modern.text: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.

original.text: עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִוָּעֵ֤ד לָכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁם

verses.restored: I will meet there with children of Israel, and it shall be sanctified by my glory.

familiar.text: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

modern.text: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.

original.text: וְנֹעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי

verses.restored: I will sanctify tent of meeting and altar, and Aaron and his sons I will sanctify to serve as priests to me.

familiar.text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.

modern.text: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests. God Will Dwell among the People

original.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת אַהֲרֹ֧ן וְאֶת בָּנָ֛יו אֲקַדֵּ֖שׁ לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי

verses.restored: I will dwell in midst of children of Israel, and I will be to them as Divine.

familiar.text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

modern.text: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

original.text: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: They shall know that I am YHWH their Divine, who brought them out from land of Egypt so that I may dwell in their midst. I am YHWH their Divine.

familiar.text: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

modern.text: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.

original.text: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְשָׁכְנִ֣י בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם

translation_notes: Ordination/filling-hand language marks priestly installation; preserve idiom.
Blood/life on ear, thumb, and toe marks hearing, doing, and walking consecrated to service.
Daily offering is tied to meeting/speaking presence, not mere ritual mechanics.
Chapter closes by returning to Exodus purpose: YHWH brought them out to dwell in their midst.
safety_note: Sacrificial material should be handled as ancient ritual symbolism of consecration, cleansing, and presence. Do not sensationalize blood or detach priesthood from accountable service.
